name: Jesus Christ - Character
description: The character and attributes of Jesus Christ. Verses that show who he is, what he values, etc.

name: Prayer
description: The act of praying, communicating with God, our Heavenly Father.

verses.note: Counseling with the Lord means praying to him. Prayer is how we bring our concerns and choices to God for his direction.
Jesus prayed to the Father, and his words were so great they could not be captured in language or writing.
